mechanism: Carbamazepine induces CYP3A4 and other metabolic enzymes, potentially reducing CoQ10 levels; additionally, carbamazepine may deplete CoQ10 through increased oxidative stress and mitochondrial effects.
action: Monitor for signs of CoQ10 deficiency (muscle weakness, fatigue); consider CoQ10 supplementation during long-term carbamazepine therapy, particularly in patients on higher doses.
